data.description:
We are seeking a quick commencement, working alongside other support workers with our clients, this team support role is based in Kippa Ring, Moreton Bay. Our centre based clients are typically children and teenagers with a range of disabilities. However we support a range of adults across Moreton Bay as well. This role has the potential to do both.

You will need to bring your high level behavioural support skills, your critical thinking, risk management and negotiation skills along with your warm, engaged and fun-loving personality.

This role is not for the faint hearted. We work with multiple neurodiverse clients, many of whom are non-verbal and considered high risk. To do this we provide a unique model of support in a purpose built centre, with community access plans and home based supports as well. You need to be able to follow a group plan, contribute effectively to strategy reviews and hold your own when managing complex behaviours, while maintaining a neuro-affirming approach to support.

You will require:

Qld WWC and NDIS Worker Screening check
Current police check
Drivers Licence, Car and comprehensive insurance
Minimum Certificate III level qualification in Individual Support, Disability, Education Support, Allied Health (OT, Speech, Physio), Early Childhood Education or a relevant field. Higher level tertiary qualifications will be highly valued and open different opportunities for promotion and development.
Current First Aid and CPR Qualifications


To physically handle the demands of this role you will need to be fit, healthy and have no lingering injuries that prevent you from a fast unexpected run at pace. You will have quick reactions. You will be happy and confident in your ability to get down to play and engage with children on the floor, and to support them while they climb and swim. You must be capable of promoting a healthy lifestyle to children, teenagers and adults in our care.

Hours vary, but you must be available after school and on Saturday’s during school terms, and on school holiday’s the more available you are the more hours you can have. This role is currently well suited to educators from special schools, teachers, allied health professionals, however we welcome anyone meeting the minimum requirements, skills, personal traits and availabilities to apply.

On offer is a fun-loving, considered risk-taking team who will help you get the best from your clients. We offer internal and external training opportunities, the use of company vehicles as needed, stable and reliable shifts for those who can do the work successfully. With regular team meetings and consultative management, an active EAP in place, we offer a supportive and dynamic work environment.

There is solid potential to grow your hours for the right fit for the clients and team. Pay is negotiable with qualifications and experience. This is an employment position, ABN holders need not apply.

data.description:
We are seeking a quick commencement, working alongside other support workers with our clients, this team support role is based in Kippa Ring, Moreton Bay. Our centre based clients are typically children and teenagers with a range of disabilities. However we support a range of adults across Moreton Bay as well. This role has the potential to do both.

You will need to bring your high level behavioural support skills, your critical thinking, risk management and negotiation skills along with your warm, engaged and fun-loving personality.

This role is not for the faint hearted. We work with multiple neurodiverse clients, many of whom are non-verbal and considered high risk. To do this we provide a unique model of support in a purpose built centre, with community access plans and home based supports as well. You need to be able to follow a group plan, contribute effectively to strategy reviews and hold your own when managing complex behaviours, while maintaining a neuro-affirming approach to support.

You will require:

Qld WWC and NDIS Worker Screening check
Current police check
Drivers Licence, Car and comprehensive insurance
Minimum Certificate III level qualification in Individual Support, Disability, Education Support, Allied Health (OT, Speech, Physio), Early Childhood Education or a relevant field. Higher level tertiary qualifications will be highly valued and open different opportunities for promotion and development.
Current First Aid and CPR Qualifications


To physically handle the demands of this role you will need to be fit, healthy and have no lingering injuries that prevent you from a fast unexpected run at pace. You will have quick reactions. You will be happy and confident in your ability to get down to play and engage with children on the floor, and to support them while they climb and swim. You must be capable of promoting a healthy lifestyle to children, teenagers and adults in our care.

Hours vary, but you must be available after school and on Saturday’s during school terms, and on school holiday’s the more available you are the more hours you can have. This role is currently well suited to educators from special schools, teachers, allied health professionals, however we welcome anyone meeting the minimum requirements, skills, personal traits and availabilities to apply.

On offer is a fun-loving, considered risk-taking team who will help you get the best from your clients. We offer internal and external training opportunities, the use of company vehicles as needed, stable and reliable shifts for those who can do the work successfully. With regular team meetings and consultative management, an active EAP in place, we offer a supportive and dynamic work environment.

There is solid potential to grow your hours for the right fit for the clients and team. Pay is negotiable with qualifications and experience. This is an employment position, ABN holders need not apply.

CAPAH Multicultural
South Nowra, Wollongong, Illawarra & South Coast NSW
Full time 
Remuneration $66,823+ superannuation per year

CAPAH Multicultural Association Incorporated Illawarra and South Coast Community Services & Development Aged & Disability Support - Servicing from Berry to Ulladulla (2540 and 2541 postcodes).
We are currently looking for Support workers to join us full time. 
The overall purpose of the role is to provide personal care and support in a range of activities of daily living intended to meet the consumer’s defined goals. These can include hygiene, dressing and grooming, community access, social support, shopping, meal preparation, respite support and domestic assistance.
To join our team, you will be dedicated, reliable and flexible, and offer the following traits:
•	Strong communication skills - both written and verbal. Especially listening and hearing what others have to say
•	Well organised, punctual, reliable and trustworthy
•	Passionate about working with people with particular needs and supporting them
•	Offer creativity, flexibility, patience and enthusiasm, and enjoy being a part of a team
•	Enjoy everyday living tasks, including cleaning, cooking, showering, shopping, and assisting people to learn these skills
•	Take pride in your work, and adapt your approach to meet the individual client’s needs.
Duties:
•	Working one-on-one with clients to provide support with their personal care such as bathing, grooming, maintaining personal hygiene and eating
•	Aiding clients with their daily treatment plans including rehabilitation exercises, delivery of medication and therapy plans
•	Assisting clients with mobility challenges, helping them move around, transfer between places, and perform exercises recommended by healthcare professionals
•	Engaging in the collaborative planning of client’s care
•	Helping clients use and maintain any necessary medical equipment or aids, such as walkers and wheelchairs
•	Maintaining accurate records of care provided, including any changes in the individual's health or specific needs
•	Communicating with healthcare professionals and family members to provide updates on clients condition and progress
Skills and experience Required:
•	Certificate III in Aged Care, Individual support, disability, community services or equivalent relevant qualification 
•	You have relevant industry work experience 
•	First Aid Certificate
•	A current National Police certificate
•	Current driver's license with registered and reliable vehicle
•	Physically capable of meeting the requirements of the role
•	Ability to pass a clearance check via NDIS 
*       NDIS modules 
•	Ability to speak a second language (Spanish)

Advertisement - Community Support Professional

Location: Mascot 2020
Salary: $77,000 till $80,000 per annum (excluding superannuation)
Job Type: Full-time

Just Better Care Eastern Suburbs is looking for passionate Community Support Professionals to join our caring and dynamic team.

We provide in-home disability and aged care services, supporting people to live independently and with dignity. We believe that people of all ages and abilities deserve access to the support and resources they need to live where and how they choose.

Our office services four key areas in the Sydney Metro region: Eastern Suburbs, Inner West, Sutherland, and St George.

About the Role

This role involves working directly with customers, supporting them in various aspects of daily living while respecting their independence, dignity, and safety. You will be providing assistance to customers with physical, mental, emotional, and social disabilities in their homes and communities.

Main Duties:

- Accompanying aged and disabled persons during daily activities
- assisting clients with their mobility
- preparing food for clients
- arranging social activities
- performing housekeeping tasks such as vacuuming and cleaning
- assisting in personal hygiene and dressing
- providing companionship, friendship and emotional support
- may do shopping and run errands
- May provide sleepover support with the client, which can include either active or inactive overnight shifts, depending on the individual's needs.
- Providing companionship, friendship and emotional support.
- The Community Support Professional provides and delivers individual and personalised support and resources to customers, so that they may continue to live in their homes.
- The Community Support Professional’s responsibilities may include, working under the guidance and supervision of medical professionals, monitoring and communicating customer’s condition to the Coordinator and/or Package Manager, transportation, light domestic duties, personal hygiene, providing meals and other health and wellness related activities.
- The Community Support Professional will demonstrate a commitment to best practice, ensuring that all services are provided in a caring and respectful way in accordance with Just Better Care’s policy and procedures.

Essential Requirements:

Essential

- Certificate III and/or IV in Individual Support, Aged Care, and/or Disability Care or relevant field.
- At least one year of relevant experience may substitute for the formal qualifications listed above. In some instances, relevant experience and/or on-the-job training may be required in addition to the formal qualification.
- NDIS Worker Screening Clearance / Criminal Record Check
- Proof of COVID-19 Vaccination
- Current First Aid certificate/CPR
- Current Australian Drivers Licence
- Reliable, registered, and insured vehicle
- Smartphone with internet access
- Proof of Working Rights in Australia (i.e. Birth Certificate/Citizenship Certificate/Passport/VISA)
- Ability to be reliably contacted via telephone and email
- Experience or willingness to assist with personal care and daily living tasks
- Reliable, punctual, and efficient in completing duties
- Respectful, client-focused attitude with a commitment to quality care
- Team-oriented with good communication and interpersonal skills
- Willingness to learn, develop skills, and participate in ongoing training
- Good written and spoken English skills for effective workplace communication

Desirable

- Current Working with Children Check (where required in accordance with state based legislation)

Why Join Just Better Care

- Be part of a close-knit, friendly, and supportive team
-  Career development and ongoing training opportunities
- Strong internal support network – we care about your success
- Competitive salary and benefits
- Access to our Employee Assistance Program

Community Support Worker - Permanent Full-Time | Sydney
Salary: From $76,515.00 to $80,000.00 per year
Permanent Full-Time
 
About Us:
 
Lumia Care is a leading innovator in Australian healthcare, comprising ten organizations with a 65-year heritage across various healthcare sectors. With a substantial staffing base and a national presence, we are on a trajectory of significant growth. We champion an inclusive, value-driven workplace, respecting our diverse team and the communities we serve.
If you have a passion for healthcare and making a real difference, Lumia Care is where you belong.
 
About the Role:
 
We are seeking experienced Community Support Workers in Sydney, NSW to provide high-care support to individuals with complex needs. This is a permanent full-time opportunity, offering a competitive salary starting at $76,515.00 per year.
 
Key Responsibilities:
•	High-Complexity Personal Care: Assist clients with mobility support, continence care, manual handling (including hoisting), PEG feeding, and medication administration under delegation.
•	Behavioral and Mental Health Support: Provide assistance to clients with complex behaviors, mental health conditions, or cognitive impairments, following behavior support plans.
•	Clinical Assistance: Work collaboratively with healthcare professionals to implement care plans, monitor client health, and respond to medical emergencies.
•	Palliative and End-of-Life Care: Offer compassionate care and support for clients with terminal illnesses, ensuring dignity and comfort.
•	Community and Social Engagement: Support clients in accessing the community, attending appointments, and participating in activities tailored to their individual goals and interests.
•	Domestic and Lifestyle Assistance: Assist with meal preparation, household tasks, and other daily living activities to maintain a safe and comfortable home environment.
•	Documentation and Reporting: Maintain accurate records of client care, incidents, and progress in compliance with NDIS and company guidelines.
What We Are Looking For:
•	Minimum 2 years of experience in high-care disability, aged care, or community support
•	Certificate III or IV in Disability, Individual Support, or Aged Care (or equivalent)
•	Experience with complex needs, manual handling, and medication assistance
•	Valid driver's license and own vehicle (required)
•	Current First Aid and CPR Certificate (mandatory)
•	Current Police Check (mandatory)
•	NDIS Worker Screening Check (mandatory)
•	Working with Children Check (preferred)
•	Up-to-date Flu and COVID-19 vaccinations
•	Strong understanding of NDIS compliance and person-centered care
Why Join Lumia Care?
•	Competitive salary starting from $76,515.00 per year
•	Permanent full-time stability
•	Supportive and inclusive team culture
How to Apply:
 
Click "Apply" on SEEK or visit https://lumiacare.com.au/ to learn more.
We welcome applications from all backgrounds, including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people and individuals from diverse communities.
